aiOverview.content: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (Thunder) is the overwhelming favorite to win the 2025-26 NBA MVP award, with odds as high as -5000 to -10000 at many sportsbooks, indicating over a 98% implied probability. He is followed by Victor Wembanyama (+2000) and Nikola Jokić (+4500 to +6000) as the regular season concludes.Top 2026 NBA MVP Odds (Post-Regular Season)Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC): -5000 to -10000 (Clear favorite)Victor Wembanyama (SAS): +2000 to +2500Nikola Jokić (DEN): +4500 to +6000Cade Cunningham (DET): +1400 (Listed in some, but lower in others)Key Factors Shaping the RaceSGA's Dominance: Gilgeous-Alexander led the Thunder to a top record in the West with 64 wins, averaging over 31 points per game and maintaining high efficiency.65-Game Rule: The league's 65-game minimum rule for awards significantly affected the field, with some contenders dropping out due to games missed.Final Odds: As of April 15, 2026, most markets viewed the race as essentially closed with SGA winning his first MVP.Note: Odds are as of April 15-16, 2026, and may not reflect real-time changes.
